groups.name: 2026 Men's Bible Reading
groups.summary: Men reading the whole Bible together from January 1 to December 31, 2026, in any translation.

groups.name: 27:17 Men
groups.when: Most Tuesdays 6–7:30 PM; every third week on Wednesday
groups.summary: Iron sharpens iron. Men committed to pushing one another toward Christ.
groups.ccSchedule: Mostly Tuesdays 6-7:30, every third week Wednesday 6-7:30

groups.name: Care & Share (Ladies)
groups.summary: Make a craft or share a talent, plus scripture, testimonies and prayer.

groups.name: Coffee & Jesus (Ladies)
groups.summary: Pitch-in breakfast and coffee while walking through the parables of Jesus.

groups.name: Discipleship Study (Men)
groups.summary: A study of how ordinary, flawed disciples were changed by time with Jesus.

groups.name: Football & Faith
groups.summary: Men watch football together after church upstairs in the Growth Track Room.

groups.name: Freedom with the Greens
groups.summary: A 13-week semester working through the Freedom small group curriculum.

groups.name: Gathered & Grounded Brownsburg
groups.summary: Women of all ages growing in God's Word with a short weekly video study.

groups.name: Grace at the Basin
groups.summary: A study of A King Washes Feet by Jessica Bond on the humility of Jesus.

groups.name: GriefShare
groups.summary: Help and encouragement after the death of a spouse, child, family member or friend.

groups.name: LiFT (Living in Faith Together)
groups.summary: Ladies of all ages deepening their walk with Jesus and building friendships.

groups.name: Loaves & Life (Women 18–30s)
groups.summary: A space for young women in every walk of life to grow, love and encourage one another.

groups.name: Men's Breakfast
groups.when: Second Saturday of every month, 8 AM
groups.summary: A big buffet breakfast and time together for the men of Venture.

groups.name: Pour It Out and Fill It Up (Ladies)
groups.summary: A laid-back group for women of all ages to connect and do life together.
groups.ccName: Pour it Out and Fill it Up (Ladies)

groups.name: Restore: Addiction & Recovery
groups.summary: For people facing active addiction, working in recovery, or who have lost a loved one to it.

groups.name: Take 5
groups.summary: Friday, family, faith, food and fun: five things every meeting focuses on.

groups.name: The Cornerstone (Young Adults)
groups.summary: A virtual young adult community figuring out adulthood together.

groups.name: The Revival Project
groups.summary: Working through the book Revival and its practices together.

groups.name: Venture 55+ Been There Done That
groups.summary: Monthly outings for men and women 55 and up. Starting back up in the spring.
groups.ccName: Venture 55+ Been There Done That (Men & Women)

groups.name: Venture Maintenance Team
groups.when: Usually after the monthly men's breakfast
groups.summary: Men and women using their skills to care for Venture's buildings.

groups.name: Venture Serve Team
groups.summary: Serving others as needs come up, plus Serve Day every July.

groups.name: Weight Release for Women
groups.summary: Releasing what holds us back, from pounds to things we carry inside.

groups.name: Well Built Women
groups.summary: Learning to live by the virtues of the Proverbs 31 woman.
